records.title: Land pooling policy and Delhi Master Plan 2041
details: e: Also , the initial draft of MPD-2041 was placed in public domain for inviting objections/ suggestions form public for 75 days. In response of public notices, approximately 34000 objections/suggestions were received and were placed before the Board of Enquiry and Hearing (BOEH) for its consideration. In regard to land pooling policy, the bottlenecks like formation of consortium, contiguity etc. are being taken care of.
